run_boost_build_regression_test: run the BoostBuild regression test that verifies project scoping when a tool module declares a project
test_boostbuild_tester_write: test the BoostBuild.Tester write method by creating a cpp source file and jam build files
test_boostbuild_tester_run_build_system: test the BoostBuild.Tester run_build_system method to invoke the b2 build process
test_boostbuild_tester_expect_addition: test the BoostBuild.Tester expect_addition method to verify a compiled executable was produced
test_boostbuild_tester_cleanup: test the BoostBuild.Tester cleanup method to remove temporary test artifacts after the build
